purpose: Define the fail-closed structural contract for a future role read-boundary guard. This draft records the minimum evidence shape for permitted local surfaces, complete trace lifetime, and ambient-input provenance bindings. It is not a runtime configuration, proof, launch instruction, or authorization.

doesNotAmend: any existing candidate, authorization, receipt, lease, terminal, role-home, or progress record

knownSurfaceClasses.meaning: Separately enumerated immutable OS/runtime inputs required only to execute the pinned runtime.
The exact individually enumerated immutable input attachment set; no parent-directory or adjacent-file implication is allowed.
A separately enumerated isolated ephemeral scratch surface with no host-backed persistent output role.
The independently pinned dependencies required solely by the guard and capture components.

guardContract.writeAuthorization: This is a read-boundary contract. It neither permits nor models writes; any write requires a separate pinned output-topology contract.

tupleAllowlistRequired.rule: A known surface class and operation value are insufficient by themselves. Every observed tuple must exactly match one pre-start sealed runtime-specific allowlist entry.

guardContract.forbiddenOrUnknownOperationDisposition: fail even when a later event asserts access denial

traceLifetimeContract.guardStartRequirement: The independently controlled guard starts before any model-visible frame and before model start.
traceLifetimeContract.guardCoverageRequirement: The guard remains live for every role/model process and child process through model stop.
traceLifetimeContract.guardStopRequirement: The guard stops only after model stop and after the final guarded event has been recorded.

pathAndEvidenceSafety.opaqueTargetRequirement: Every access event names only a verifier-defined opaque target identifier; the identifier must not encode a host, workspace, role-home, user-profile, network, or provider locator.
permittedRoleVisibleEvidenceFields: fixed booleans, enums, and non-negative counts
prohibitedRoleVisibleEvidenceContent: UNC path, drive mapping, URI, URL, socket address, DNS name, or provider locator
raw prompt, instruction, session, history, tool, plugin, connector, MCP, or policy content
role stdout, role-authored arbitrary JSON, or implementation-authored self-report
credential, metadata, environment value, or raw filesystem listing

independentVerifierRequirements: The verifier and protected capture agent are outside the implementation identity and coordinator administration boundary.
The verifier signature is validated against a trust anchor outside the coordinator administration boundary.
The implementation identity cannot disable, replace, reconfigure, or route around the guard or capture agent.
runtimeAcceptancePreconditions: A separately byte-pinned typed validator and independently audited synthetic adversarial fixture suite exist.
The selected topology demonstrates denied hidden-instruction injection, session resumption, tool injection, and post-start control delivery without reading P-3 material.
A distinct owner authorization exists before any provider account, hardware, network, sandbox, VM, delivery, or role launch action.

failClosedConditions: Any required binding, source artifact, hash, signature, trust-anchor validation, or lifecycle observation is absent, unreadable, stale, self-authored-only, or mismatched.
Any unknown or forbidden surface class, operation, target tuple, input frame, child process, tool definition, tool invocation, network endpoint, or post-start inbound control is observed.
The guard or capture starts late, stops early, contains a gap, omits a child, or is not independently controlled for the complete runtime lifetime.
A source coverage class, invocation frame, runtime/control-plane surface, or evidence-safety check is unobservable, provider-asserted-only, partial, truncated, or unknown.
Any evidence discloses a prohibited locator or raw content, or reaches the evidence root through a symlink, junction, reparse point, or hard link.
Any record uses this draft, a synthetic result, a model answer, a configuration flag, a canary nonappearance, or an owner/role self-report as a real-runtime clean-room PASS.

syntheticFixtureBoundary.onlyPermittedConclusion: The synthetic validator rejects the specified malformed fixtures.

requiredFinalStatement: role read-boundary guard contract: synthetic workspace-only draft; no real runtime was tested; P-11 remains NOT_AUTHORIZED; no delivery, launch, implementation, return, measurement, accessibility, motion, or gate action is authorized.
